answers.workaround:
It is possible to load a resource and then resave it immediately:
```gdscript
var res = ResourceLoader.load(input_file)
out.error = ResourceSaver.save(res, output_file)
```
Which results in a file with a unique UID, but might be slow on big files, and also introduces small amount of complexity to my use case, where I also want to handle non Resource files.
